title: Foundations
desc: GNSS and its threats, then the engineer's toolkit: Linux, Python with classes and NumPy, data analysis and git.

title: Geodesy, maps and images
desc: WGS84, ECEF and ENU frames, Web Mercator tiles and MBTiles, and images as arrays: filters and affine warps.

title: ROS 2: nodes, topics and contracts
desc: The DDS graph and QoS, publishers and subscribers as classes, NAVERA's position contract, launch files and testing.

title: Sensors and their models
desc: NMEA and DOP, rotations and quaternions, attitude from the IMU, the camera matrix, fisheye calibration and timing a live camera.

title: Vision-based navigation
desc: Features, homographies with RANSAC, locating a photo on the map, visual odometry, then navigating by heat and by the stars.

title: Fusion, uncertainty and integrity
desc: Covariance, gating and fusion, the Kalman filter, the arbiter as a state machine, and spoofing detection as hypothesis testing.

title: System, measurement and project
desc: Fault injection in SITL, honest statistics with confidence intervals, and your own measured improvement to NAVERA.
